description:
Throwaway-friendly prototype to iterate on visual data display and find out which views are actually valuable, before committing to the authed premium dashboard in T-056. Explicitly NOT behind auth and not deployed.

RELATION TO T-056: T-056 is the paid, authenticated web dashboard, blocked by T-045 (durable accounts). This prototype is deliberately unblocked — it runs locally against ~/.zug and needs no account system. Findings from it should feed T-056's eventual scope. Do not close T-056 with this.

APPROVED DESIGN (2026-08-30):

Vehicle: new /dashboard route in the existing web/ Next.js app. Server component, `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` so a refresh re-reads disk.

Data access — deliberately NOT src/storage.ts, for two reasons:
1. web/ is its own pnpm workspace package whose tsconfig only includes app/**; importing across it means build config surgery.
2. storage.ts functions call ensureDirs(), which WRITES to the data dir. A dashboard render must never mutate ~/.zug.
So: web/lib/zug-data.ts, ~80 lines of fs + JSONL/markdown parsing, strictly read-only, honouring ZUG_DATA_DIR with ~/.zug fallback.

web/lib/zug-metrics.ts — derived series, kept pure so they are unit-testable:
- observations/week bucketed from observations.jsonl timestamps. NOT from sessionCount, which is non-monotonic (199 -> 200 -> 176 -> 174 -> 216 -> 218 -> 188 -> 233 -> 197 -> 240 -> 190) because it counts whatever is on disk at snapshot time and 90-day archiving plus multi-device sync makes it bounce. Any chart drawn from it would be wrong.
- sessions/day counted from sessions/*.md filenames
- personaLines history deduped to actual transitions
- consolidation gap: observations accumulated since the last personaLines change

Page sections, diagnostic-first (deliberate: the pipeline failure is the most valuable thing the data reveals, so it leads rather than hides below a growth curve):
1. Pipeline Health — surfaces ISS-045/046/047: synthesis failing, actual-vs-timeout, max_tokens headroom, PERSONA frozen since 2026-05-23, lessons 0, reinforcements 3.
2. Cadence — observations/week and sessions/day on a shared time axis. Shows the March burst (46) and April collapse (11), and that sessions and observations run on different horizons since sessions only go back to June after archiving.
3. What is accumulating — type x confidence. cognitive_pattern 54, context 35, preference 33, mistake 5, breakthrough 3. The rare mistake/breakthrough entries broken out separately as the highest-signal content.
4. Recurrence clustering — runs the existing wordSimilarity/findBestMatch matcher over the 130 observations client-side, read-only, with a live threshold slider. This makes the "patterns graduating into lessons" view render real data on day one instead of a blank panel, AND lets the similarity threshold be tuned visually against the real corpus before ISS-048 wires it to an automatic gate.
5. Persona browser — the 6 PERSONA sections and ~81 bullets, expandable, with the session citations some bullets already carry.

Charts: inline SVG, no chart library. Load the dataviz skill before writing chart code so palette/axis treatment is consistent.

DEPLOY SAFETY: web/ deploys to Fly (web/Dockerfile, web/fly.toml). A route reading ~/.zug does not exist in that container. Gate with `if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') notFound()` so it cannot ship alongside the landing page.

TESTING: vitest is already configured in web/. Test the pure functions in zug-metrics.ts against fixture JSONL — weekly bucketing, gap calculation, persona section parsing, clustering. Not the React rendering; the visuals are what gets iterated by eye.

OUT OF SCOPE (v1): auth, the unresolved next-steps/blockers aggregator, cross-session search, deployment, and anything that writes.
title: Local dashboard prototype — diagnostic-first view of Zug pipeline health and growth data (no auth)
